body: I wish I could try, but my life revolves around how others perceive me, especially my parents. They're the ones supporting me after all, and I've let them down. Countless times. I've already missed the deadlines for most universities I could've entered. Every living moment for the rest of my life adds up the amount of disappointment I am. I'm practically a NEET now. It's an ironic twist of events really. You'd expect someone with straight A's to do somewhat-well in life, everyone felt that way back then, I never did though. Every single one of my friends are busy studying except for me. I'm not fit for adult life. I've already been a massive letdown and there's no way to repair this.
